texts.value: Rab GTPase that acts as a dynein adapter protein, thereby activating dynein-mediated transport and dynein-dynactin motility on microtubules (PubMed:30814157). RASEF-mediated dynein motility is Ca(2+)-independent (PubMed:30814157). Also regulates the formation and sorting of zymogen granules and secretion of digestive enzymes by pancreatic acinar cells (By similarity)
Homodimer (PubMed:17448446). Interacts with the dynein-dynactin complex (PubMed:30814157)
Mostly diffusely distributed in the cytoplasm and partially localized to Golgi and endo-lysosomes in pancreatic cells
Down-regulated in cutaneous melanoma cells but not in breast cancer cells
Belongs to the small GTPase superfamily. Rab family
